into a fresh output directory; never merge or reuse a blocked attempt's partial output.

## skills

`npx hyperframes skills` is the person's one-time setup: it adds the HyperFrames skill pack (/hyperframes with its references, /hyperframes-cli, /hyperframes-registry, /media-use, /figma, /slideshow, /remotion-to-hyperframes, /reverse-any-video, /style-sampling) to the local AI coding environment so agents follow the framework conventions. Skills are versioned with the CLI; after a HyperFrames upgrade the person can refresh them with `npx hyperframes skills update`. Tell them when that applies; do not run it yourself.
